defaultNotificationTarget.note: Notify the active Discord channel for project-owner review and merge decisions.

notes: Project-level notification routing for local agents working on TripleQuadUI.
Notify in Discord when a feature is ready for project-owner code review and manual merge to master.
If review is rejected, the feature branch must be fixed and re-reviewed before merge.
Do not hard-code phone numbers or emails in agent prompts.
